notes: syncEdges: eight Envoy routes proxy to upstream clusters, each read at the route line (envoy.tmpl.yaml:40-55). Protocol for all eight is HTTP: the HTTP connection manager is codec_type AUTO (envoy.tmpl.yaml:15-16), and none of these clusters sets an HTTP/2 option (cluster blocks envoy.tmpl.yaml:99-158). Upstream HTTP/1.1 is a library default, not in these files. The only HTTP/2 option is on opentelemetry_collector_grpc (envoy.tmpl.yaml:73-77), which is telemetry export, not a synchronous call edge. Callee host names come from the .env lines cited in each edge's note.

syncEdges callee names: the flagservice cluster (envoy.tmpl.yaml:123-134) resolves to FLAGD_HOST=flagd (.env:129), so the callee is flagd. The loadgen cluster (envoy.tmpl.yaml:147-158) resolves to LOCUST_WEB_HOST=loadgenerator (.env:95).
publishesTo: none stated. No Kafka or message-broker configuration in the frontendproxy files.
registersWith: none stated. No registry, discovery or coordinator client in the frontendproxy files, and no registry block in the deployment files.
liveness: none stated for this service. The schema places liveness only on coordinators, and no coordinator is defined here.

replicas: no deploy.replicas or scale key in docker-compose.yml:311-355 or in modules/otel-demo/deployment/compose.candidate-postures.yml:74-76. Compose default of 1; library default, not in these files.

health check: no healthcheck key in docker-compose.yml:311-355 and none in compose.candidate-postures.yml:74-76. Not configured in these files. The Envoy admin listener at envoy.tmpl.yaml:183-187 is not a health check configuration.

container: Dockerfile:4 sets FROM envoyproxy/envoy:v1.30-latest and Dockerfile:11 runs envsubst on envoy.tmpl.yaml, then envoy -c envoy.yaml. compose.candidate-postures.yml:76 mounts OTEL_CANDIDATE_ENVOY_CONFIG over /home/envoy/envoy.tmpl.yaml, so the posture overlay can replace the template.

telemetry, traces: the Envoy OpenTelemetry tracer (envoy.tmpl.yaml:18-28, provider at line 21) exports over gRPC to cluster opentelemetry_collector_grpc (envoy.tmpl.yaml:70-86), which resolves to OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST=otelcol (.env:27) and OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_GRPC (compose environment line 337). Export timeout is 0.250s (envoy.tmpl.yaml:27). The export frequency or batch interval is not stated in these files; any default is a library default, not in these files.

telemetry, metrics: no metrics exporter or stats sink is configured in envoy.tmpl.yaml. The otelcol httpcheck/frontendproxy receiver at otelcol-config.yml:15-17 probes this service from the collector side. That is inbound to this service, not sent by it, and is not reported as an export.
telemetry, logs: no access_log or log exporter is configured in envoy.tmpl.yaml. Not stated in these files.
compose.yml:322-324 publishes ports ${ENVOY_PORT}:${ENVOY_PORT} and 10000:10000. Port 10000 matches the admin listener at envoy.tmpl.yaml:186-187.
